_note: The mount registry. This is where a prototype is ADAPTED to the shell, so that the prototype file itself never has to be. A row names a file by relative path and names the selectors inside it that mean 'dismiss' and 'primary action'. Nothing is copied and nothing is rewritten — adaptation lives here, in one line, per file.
_external_note: Anything under external/ is a REAL file living elsewhere in this repo, referenced by relative path. It is not copied here and it is not edited. It is mounted to prove the contract against an artifact baby-PAI did not author.
